sloka: ततः सूर्य निकाशेन रथेन महता खरः ।आससाद अथ तम् रामम् पतंग इव पावकम् ॥३-२८-१४॥
transliteration: tataḥ sūrya nikāśena rathena mahatā kharaḥ ।āsasāda atha tam rāmam pataṁga iva pāvakam ॥3-28-14॥

translations.english: Then Khara mounting a great chariot which was glowing like the Sun, advanced towards Rama just as an insect hurtles towards fire.
